title: DH Lock V3
features:
CapLock & ESP = ESP and Lock only one that user, and any other selected.
Spectate Player = Click on username to spectate, and click red button at bottom to stop.
Keybind Mode: Right Click Mouse, Left Click Mouse, E, And F. (click to switch)
Target Part: Humanoid Rootpart, Head, and Legs. (click to switch)

When you select the player VIA the player list on the Middle panel, It will ESP their Name & body from anywhere on the map even after death. When you select the user lock will only go onto that specific user, not anybody else that isnt on ESP, unless they're selected.

KeyBinds:
Y = Toggles camlock on and off

P = Toggles Wall Check on and off

V = opens and closes Menu

works on all fakes and other games too
DHL means Da Hood Lock.
